mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hydra_device_namespace_node (guid, name, alias, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{guid}, #{name}, #{alias}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE hydra_device_namespace_node SET name = #{name}, alias = #{alias}, description = #{description}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE guid = #{guid}
